paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah, beginning of chapter 3, reporting in R' Yochanan’s name.[^1]

notes.text: רפ״ג is read conventionally as beginning of chapter3; the older candidate's end wording conflicts with that reading and is not adopted. No modern folio is supplied or verified. He is the contextual heading subject; Yochanan's personal title is abbreviated and retained as R'. The named Avodah Zarah passage and modern edition division have not been independently checked here.
